status: Supplemental per-section caps declared before section comparison; not an acceptance or an enlargement of final-file/code caps.
native_allocated_sections: Each existing allocated executable section independently uses the artifact code cap; every other allocated section independently uses its file cap, both absolute and percentage. No newly allocated sections may grow from an absent or zero baseline.
wasm_sections: Every existing WASM code section uses the code cap; other existing section types independently use the file cap, both absolute and percentage. No newly introduced section types may grow from an absent or zero baseline.
code_metric: Entire final native executable-section total and WASM code-section size conservatively include all emitted monomorphized code. These totals do not establish an individual-symbol size claim.
